sizing_gate.reason: 8 files, but ONE concern: a single dashboard card. 4 of the 8 are the tests this ticket's own contract mandates (card-order assertion, the second hardcoded card count, the new query-class test, the new widget test). The remaining 4 are 2 new app classes plus 2 one-line edits (a cards() insertion and a getStatColor() arm). The DEV-2409 epic is ALREADY split one-metric-per-ticket, so this ticket IS the split unit; splitting further would ship a query class with no consumer, or a widget with no data source. Precedent: DEV-2460 in this same epic fired this gate and recorded the same rejection.

perf_gate.basis: prior-measurement (DEV-2466, production ClickHouse Cloud, 2026-09-08). Both adopted shapes are individually measured; the unmeasured combined shape is deliberately NOT adopted.

excluded_sites.reason: Pre-existing hardcoded `clarity.` prefix. Named by the ticket as the bug NOT to copy, not as work to retrofit. Out of blast radius.
Latent bug in the sibling card. This ticket avoids inheriting it by targeting scans_cold on purpose; fixing ScanCount is a different ticket.
Dead code (single occurrence, its own definition). One Build Record line, no code change.

A second card registry, but the Playwright specs iterate defensively and skip absent keys, so omission is a coverage gap not a failure. Deliberately excluded to keep the diff to the PHP contract; DEV-2483 owns e2e coverage for this card suite.
Client-portal panel, unrelated to Company Metrics.

subtasks.title: Unique Scan Counts card: query class, widget, registration, tests
subtasks.approach: TDD, in dependency order. Build ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery first (it has no dependencies), then the widget that consumes it, then the two registration edits, then fix the two hardcoded card counts. Every ClickHouse decision is already settled by DEV-2466 and recorded in prep-context.json - implement those shapes exactly, do not re-derive them.

intended_diffs.app/Clickhouse/Queries/ScanPlateStatsBat: NEW, declare(strict_types=1). Structural copy of HitPlateStatsBatchQuery: private DATETIME_PATTERN + assertDatetime() allowlist, private static fromAndWhere() shared by both entry points, static::clarityDb() for the prefix, DB::connection('clarity_clickhouse')->select(). WHERE org_id = {orgId} AND scanned_at >= toDateTime('{start}') AND scanned_at <= toDateTime('{end}') AND _peerdb_is_deleted = 0. NO FINAL, NO `clarity.` literal, NO kit_id routing. handle(): SELECT toStartOfMonth(scanned_at) AS month, uniqExact(ocr) AS unique_plates ... GROUP BY month ORDER BY month -> array<string 'Y-m', int>. handleRange(): SELECT kit_id, uniqExact(ocr) AS unique_plates ... GROUP BY kit_id WITH ROLLUP -> array<int kitId, int>, where key 0 is the org total. PLUS a public static sharedRangeCacheKey(int $orgId, string $start, string $end): string returning a CLASS-NEUTRAL key ('scan-plate-stats:unique-range:org={org}:{start}:{end}', spaces replaced) - this is the DEV-2468 sharing seam and it must NOT go through DashboardWidget::buildWidgetCacheKey(), which prefixes the WIDGET class basename and is therefore unreadable from a sibling card. Docblock records: why no FINAL (DEV-2466 sec 5, ocr immutable across CDC versions - the OPPOSITE of hits_cold), why org_id and never kit_id (DEV-2466 sec 1c, 6.7x rows / 3.8x time for an identical answer), why scans_cold and never scans_hot (sec 6, 3.3x slower on 5x the parts), and why handle() does NOT carry the kit dimension (the combined 13-month x per-kit rollup was never measured; sec 4 and sec 7 measured the two shapes separately).

Its own monthKeyStart() anchoring day-01 before month arithmetic (ScanCount:80-83 - resolving '2026-06' on the 31st otherwise overflows to July). getRangeTotal() returns fetchRangeRollup($start,$end)[0] ?? 0 with NO try/catch, honouring the base class's documented contract that a bounded-window failure must propagate rather than persist a fabricated 0 under a shared key. canViewCardData(): guest short-circuit true, then static::canView() && (Feature::active(FeatureEnum::COMPANY_METRICS->slug()) || session()->has('admin_impersonator')) - StagingLiveHitLeader's exact shape (Q3). NO description copy about the divergences (Q2).

ordered_steps: 1. Baseline: run the AC-relevant tests BEFORE any change and record pass/fail, so a pre-existing failure is never misread as a regression.
2. TDD the query class: write tests/Feature/Clickhouse/ScanPlateStatsBatchQueryTest.php first, confirm RED, then implement ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery until GREEN.
3. TDD the widget: write tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/UniqueScanCountsTest.php, confirm RED, then implement UniqueScanCounts until GREEN.
4. Registration: insert into cards() at index 2 and add the getStatColor() arm; update the mockup docblock and its stale alignment prose.
5. Fix the two hardcoded card counts (DashboardCardExpansionTest:94 and DashboardCardVisibilityTest:191) and the layout-order expectation.
8. Full suite via vendor/bin/phpunit with a raised memory_limit; compare against the step-1 baseline, not against zero.
invariants: NEVER a hardcoded `clarity.` prefix - static::clarityDb() only.
NEVER FINAL on scans_cold for this aggregate.
NEVER filter or route via kit_id to reach an org - org_id leads the sort key.
NEVER re-derive date/month arithmetic - resolveCardRange() and a day-01-anchored monthKeyStart() only.
NEVER route the batch through ClickhouseQuery::query() - it swallows Throwable to [] in production|testing, which would cache a failure as a zero.
NEVER put the DEV-2468-shared key through buildWidgetCacheKey() - that prefixes the widget class basename and a sibling card could not read it.
NEVER add try/catch inside getRangeTotal() - the base class documents why a bounded-window failure must propagate.
